questions.text: Read the provided technical passage on "Artificial Intelligence in Structural Health Monitoring of Bridges and Infrastructure". Answer the comprehension questions, infer contextual meanings of technical terms, and write a concise summary (precis) in one-third of its original length.
Write a formal business letter of inquiry to a construction equipment manufacturer requesting a quotation, delivery schedule, and technical specifications for heavy-duty concrete batching plants.

Explain the standard structural components of a formal Engineering Feasibility Report (Letter of Transmittal, Title Page, Executive Summary, Table of Contents, Introduction, Methodology, Findings, Cost Analysis, Conclusions, Recommendations, and References).

Draft a formal Technical Project Proposal to the Department of Roads, Nepal, seeking funding for a feasibility study on "Solar-Powered Smart Traffic Signal Systems in Kathmandu Valley". Include Problem Statement, Objectives, Scope of Work, Methodology, Work Plan (Gantt Chart), Budget Estimate, and Expected Outcomes.
